title: Schwab trader
goal: Prove on paper, with a real closed-trade track record, whether the two-brain strategy has an edge, before a single real dollar is at risk

project.why: Drafted 2026-09-10 from README.md, STRATEGY.md and its open issues: the executor watchdog has reported a stall for over a month (#15), a sell approval has waited since June 26 (#5), and the BUY brain is paused. High risk: every change waits for Caleb to merge.

steps.text: Answer the sell approval waiting since June 26 (schwab-trader issue #5): comment approve, hold, or close it
Find out why the executor hasn't run in over a month (issue #15): the cron-job.org trigger stopped, or SCHWAB_REFRESH_TOKEN expired, and only you can log in to either
Make the watchdog say which of the two likely causes a stall is (no trigger runs at all, or runs that fail) so the next stall names itself
Decide whether to resume the BUY brain, paused when its Claude quota ran out
Once 30 paper trades have closed, write the edge report (win rate, expectancy, by signal) and say plainly whether the strategy has earned the right to trade real money
